title: Extreme heat and hyperthermia: hot rooms, heat domes, outdoor exposure, and the death that may look quiet

moment.plain_scene: In heat-related death, the room may look ordinary: a hot apartment, a worksite, a stopped fan, a closed window, a shaded yard, or a body found after the heat has already done its work.
